{{Quote|If you won't use a mechno-limb, this powerchair will have to do.''"<br />"''You'll not be making me into a half-droid, that's for sure. This little buggy will do fine.|[[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
A '''repulsorlift chair''' was a one-being, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-powered floating chair also known as a '''hover chair''' or '''power chair'''.

==Characteristics==
repulsorlift chairs used basic antigravity technology to lift the chair above the ground, and were controlled via a panel on the armrest. These chairs were commonly used by disabled, wounded or elderly beings.

==History==
[[File:YodaHoverChair.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] using a hover chair.]]

[[Aarrba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] used a hover chair around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] as did most Hutts throughout galactic history, due to their enormous weight on most humanoid-compatible planets.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Vandar Tokare]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] were known to use hoverchairs during their later years, to keep pace with their [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] companions.

The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], around the length of its hearing room tables, used repulsorlift chairs that adjusted to the heights of many differing species.

[[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]] was forced to use a power chair after losing his leg during an encounter with [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], and both [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] used power chairs after sustaining injuries to their lower bodies&mdash;the former after [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] crashed his [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] into Veers's [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]], the latter after an encounter with [[Tsavong Lah]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].

[[Bertroff Hissa]] used a hoverchair after losing his arms and legs, though at this point he had been given [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] replacements.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used a hoverchair after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] while he recovered from being [[Force lightning/Legends|electrocuted]] nearly to death by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Behind the scenes==
The power chair was a 60 month veteran reward for players of the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
